job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
A growing retail business in Crediton is looking to appoint a commercially minded Finance Manager to take ownership of its financial reporting, management information, and finance systems.

This is a hands-on role with genuine influence. You’ll sit at the heart of decision-making, ensuring the numbers don’t just add up but actively drive better performance across the business.

This is not a passive reporting role. It’s for someone who wants to improve how the business understands itself through data.

The Role

Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be responsible for:

  • Producing accurate and timely monthly management accounts (P&L, balance sheet and cashflow)
  • Delivering commercial insight to support trading, margin and stock decisions
  • Leading budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis
  • Developing and improving financial systems, reporting tools and data flows
  • Acting as the finance partner to operational and commercial teams
  • Ensuring strong financial controls, reconciliations and audit readiness
  • Driving automation and process improvement within finance
  • Managing and developing junior finance staff (where applicable)

This role suits someone who enjoys getting under the bonnet of the numbers and the systems behind them, not just reporting performance, but improving how it’s measured and used.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in a Finance Manager / Management Accountant type role
  • Background in retail, FMCG, wholesale or a similar fast-moving environment
  • Strong systems and data capability – comfortable improving ERP, reporting, Excel/BI tools and workflows
  • Commercially minded, with the ability to translate data into action
  • Hands-on, pragmatic and comfortable in a growing, evolving business
  • Part or fully qualified (ACA / ACCA / CIMA), or qualified by experience

Why Join?

  • Play a key role in a £35m turnover retail business with real operational influence
  • High visibility with senior leadership
  • Opportunity to shape systems, reporting and the future finance function
  • A business that values finance as a strategic partner, not a back-office function
  • Competitive salary and benefits, depending on experience

Gravitate values a diverse workforce. Women, people of colour, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQ+ community are strongly encouraged to apply

job.title: Management Accountant
job.description:
We're partnering with a highly regarded, values-led consumer brand to recruit a Management Accountant into a growing finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded accountant who enjoys getting into the detail, partnering with stakeholders and helping drive business performance.

The Opportunity

This role offers far more than month end reporting. You'll play a key role in providing insight to the wider business, improving processes and supporting strategic decision making within a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Preparing monthly management accounts for multiple entities
  • Producing meaningful analysis and commentary on performance
  • Supporting budgeting and forecasting processes
  • Monitoring performance against budget and highlighting risks and opportunities
  • Business partnering with operational teams across the organisation
  • Conducting cost and profitability analysis
  • Supporting process improvements and finance automation initiatives
  • Assisting with audit requirements and ensuring strong financial controls and compliance.

About You

We're keen to speak with individuals who are:
  • ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified or part-qualified
  • Experienced in preparing management accounts within a fast-paced environment
  • Strong users of Excel and finance systems
  • Commercially minded and naturally curious
  • Confident communicating with both finance and non-finance stakeholders
  • Proactive, hands-on and keen to improve processes
  • Comfortable working independently whilst also being a collaborative team player.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a purpose-led business that genuinely invests in its people and encourages continuous learning and development. You'll be joining a supportive team where ideas are welcomed, collaboration is encouraged and you'll have the chance to make a visible impact from day one.
